actions.label: Cut the line
actions.npcMessage: Someone slips in ahead of you without a word.

actions.label: Wait patiently
actions.npcMessage: Someone near you waits quietly, tapping their foot.

actions.label: Wait patiently but become angry
actions.npcMessage: A stranger exhales loudly, radiating quiet fury.

actions.label: Bribe people with money
actions.npcMessage: Someone ahead waves a crumpled bill and whispers a deal.

effects.text: You slide a few dollars forward. The line budges.

actions.label: Bribe people with candy
actions.npcMessage: A person ahead offers candy to the crowd like a peace treaty.

effects.text: You pass out candy. Spirits lift. The line moves.

actions.label: Cut the line yourself
actions.npcMessage: Someone shoves past you with zero shame.

actions.label: Scream incoherently
actions.npcMessage: Someone screams gibberish. The whole line flinches.

effects.text: You let out an incoherent scream. Everyone stares.

actions.label: Listen to music silently
actions.npcMessage: Someone bobs their head to silent earbuds. You only notice the twitching.

actions.label: Listen to music with no headphones
actions.npcMessage: Someone blasts music from their phone speaker. You hear every lyric.

effects.text: Your music fills the queue. Heads turn.

actions.label: FaceTime with no headphones
actions.npcMessage: Someone starts a speakerphone FaceTime about their cousin's wedding.

effects.text: You FaceTime on speaker. The entire line hears both sides.
